subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw accept per-agent daily spend alerting as a supported core configuration and persistent agent-state feature, rather than keeping cost awareness in existing pull-based usage views or an extension surface?
rationale: The branch is not a narrow bug fix: it introduces a public config contract, durable data model, and cross-channel reply behavior. The linked issue has no recorded maintainer sponsorship despite already being marked as requiring a product decision.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed core feature
options.body: Confirm the core ownership and accept the opt-in configuration after owner-private runtime and upgrade proof is added.

options.title: Route to an extension design
options.body: Keep core usage views unchanged and define the missing extension or plugin seam if proactive spend reporting should be optional.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the issue and draft PR open without merge commitment until a maintainer prioritizes the capability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed core feature
recommendation.body: Confirm the core ownership and accept the opt-in configuration after owner-private runtime and upgrade proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns core product scope across agents, configuration, SQLite state, and channel delivery rather than a local implementation detail.
